### [hyprland-wiki/configuring/core/animations.md] animations › Bezier
A cubic [Bézier curve](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/B%C3%A9zier_curve) is a simple spline defined by 4 points, two of which (the middle ones) are configurable.

```lua
hl.curve( NAME, { type = "bezier", points = { {X0, Y0}, {X1, Y1} } })
```

[cssportal.com](https://www.cssportal.com/css-cubic-bezier-generator/) can be a useful website to design your own Bézier.
If you want to instead choose from a list of pre-made Béziers, you can check out [easings.net](https://easings.net).

Voici l'architecture complète du projet Hyprland/Waybar/Quickshell :

## 🏗️ Architecture du Projet

### **1. Noyau Hyprland (`hypr/hyprland.lua`)**
Point d'entrée principal qui charge tous les modules via `require`. Structure modulaire par fonctionnalité :

```
hypr/hyprland.lua
├── hl.config() → Configuration générale (gaps, border, blur)
├── hl.monitor() → Gestion des écrans
├── hl.env() → Variables d'environnement
├── hl.on("hyprland.start", ...) → Démarrage Waybar et autres services
├── hl.bind(...) → Bindings clavier/souris (toujours via hl.dsp.*)
├── hl.curve() → Courbes de Bézier personnalisées
├── hl.animation() → Animations (leaf, enabled, speed, bezier)
├── hl.window_rule() → Règles de fenêtres (float, ignore, etc.)
├── hl.layer_rule() → Règles de couches (blur, zpos, etc.)
└── hl.workspace_rule() → Règles d'espaces de travail
```

### **2. Modules Hyprland (`hypr/conf/`)**
Chaque fichier correspond à une fonctionnalité spécifique :

| Fichier | Rôle |
|---------|------|
| `animations.lua` | Configuration des animations (inclut sous-dossier `/fast`, `/md3`, `/none`, `/smooth`) |
| `autostart.lua` | Applications lancées au démarrage |
| `custom.lua` | Modules personnalisés et scripts |
| `env.lua` | Variables d'environnement système |
| `gestures.lua` | Gestes de souris (pinch, swipe) |
| `input.lua` | Configuration clavier/souris/touchpad (`input = { kb_layout = "fr", follow_mouse = 1 }`) |
| `keybinds/` | Bindings organisés par catégorie : apps, media, screenshots, switches, system, windows, workspaces |
| `layerrules.lua` | Règles de couches (blur, zpos) |
| `layouts.lua` | Layouts d'espaces de travail (master-detail, etc.) |
| `look-and-feel.lua` | Thèmes, couleurs, effets visuels |
| `misc.lua` | Options diverses et expérimentales |
| `monitors.lua` + `/auto.lua`, `/extended.lua`, etc. | Configuration multi-écrans (auto, extended, mirror, external-only, laptop-only) |
| `windowrules.lua` | Règles de fenêtres spécifiques par classe/nom |
| `workspaces.lua` | Gestion des espaces de travail (noms, gaps) |

### **3. Bibliothèque Utilitaire (`hypr/lib/`)**
- `colors.lua` : Palettes de couleurs centralisées
- `settings.lua` : Système de configuration persistant

### **4. Thèmes et Hyprlock (`hypr/themes/`, `hypr/hyprlock*`)**
- `themes/current.lua` → Thème actif (charge depuis `default.lua`)
- `hyprlock.conf` + `hyprlock-colors.conf` → Configuration du verrouillage d'écran

### **5. Scripts (`hypr/scripts/`)**
Organisation par fonctionnalité :

| Catégorie | Fichiers | Rôle |
|-----------|----------|------|
| **Système** | `idle.sh`, `wallpaper-daemon.sh`, `updates.sh`, `nightlight.sh` | Gestion idle, wallpapers, mises à jour, nightlight |
| **Fenêtres** | `toggle.sh`, `toggle-allfloat.sh`, `screenshot.sh` | Toggle fullscreen, float, screenshots |
| **Notifications** | `notifications.sh`, `notif-log.sh`, `osd.sh` | Système de notifications |
| **Audio/Média** | `radio.sh`, `battery-alert.sh`, `deskpet.sh` | Radio, alertes batterie, deskpet |
| **Menu/Interface** | `launcher.sh`, `quickpanel.sh`, `settings-ui.sh`, `rofi-theme.sh` | Lanceurs, menus, UI settings |
| **Périphériques** | `bluetooth.sh`, `wifi.sh`, `power.sh` | Bluetooth, WiFi, alimentation |
| **Utilitaires** | `lock.sh`, `scripts/lib.sh`, `wallpaper-daemon.sh` | Fonctions communes, verrouillage |

### **6. Waybar (`waybar/`)**
Architecture modulaire JSONC + CSS :

```
waybar/
├── __pycache__/ → Cache Python (IPC proxy)
├── build.py → Script de compilation des modules
├── catalog.tsv → Catalogue des modules disponibles
├── ipc-proxy.py → Proxy IPC pour les modules personnalisés
├── modules/*.jsonc → Modules Waybar (workspaces, clock, battery, etc.)
│   ├── workspaces.jsonc → Espaces de travail Hyprland
│   ├── window.jsonc → Barre de titre Hyprland
│   ├── mpris.jsonc → Lecteur média MPRIS
│   ├── pulseaudio.jsonc → Volume audio
│   ├── battery.jsonc → Batterie
│   ├── clock.jsonc → Horloge
│   ├── notifications.jsonc → Notifications
│   ├── launcher.jsonc → Lanceur d'applications
│   ├── tray.jsonc → Barre des applications système
│   └── ... (cpu, memory, network, etc.)
└── style/
    ├── base.css → Styles de base
    ├── colors.css → Palettes de couleurs
    ├── modules/*.css → Styles par module
    └── presets/*.css → Préstyles (capsules, encre, floating, hyde, minimal, solid)
```

### **7. Quickshell (`quickshell/`)** *(non présent dans la liste mais documenté)*
Widgets QML organisés par dossier :
- `quickshell/<nom>/shell.qml` → Fichier principal du widget
- Composants `<Nom>.qml` à côté pour réutilisabilité
- Services intégrés : Hyprland, Io, Pipewire, UPower, Mpris, SystemTray, Notifications

### **8. Configuration Spéciale**
- `hypr/settings.conf` + `settings.schema` → Schéma de configuration (liberté vs rigueur)
- `hypr/idle/hypridle.conf.tpl` → Template pour Hypridle
- `hypr/monitors.conf` → Configuration globale multi-écrans

### **9. Fichiers Spéciaux**
- `hypr/workspaces.conf` → Espaces de travail (legacy ou fallback)
- `hypr/settings.conf` → Options globales persistantes

---

## 🔄 Flux d'Exécution Typique

1. **Démarrage Hyprland** → `hypr/hyprland.lua` charge tous les modules
2. **Initialisation** → `hl.config()`, `hl.monitor()`, `hl.env()`
3. **Bindings** → `hl.bind(...)` pour clavier/souris/gestes
4. **Règles** → `window_rule`, `layer_rule`, `workspace_rule`
5. **Démarrage services** → `hl.on("hyprland.start", ...)` lance Waybar, wallpapers, etc.
6. **Waybar** → `waybar.sh` démarre avec config JSONC + CSS
7. **Scripts** → Exécutés selon événements (notifications, idle, updates)

---

Cette architecture modulaire permet une maintenance facile : chaque fonctionnalité est isolée dans un fichier dédié, et la validation se fait par module (`verify_hyprland`, `verify_waybar`, `verify_quickshell`).

La validation passe. Relis maintenant la DEMANDE point par point et vérifie avec read_file que CHAQUE point est réellement présent dans les fichiers (position, couleurs exactes, modules, raccourcis…). Ne supprime rien qui sert la demande. Si un point manque ou est faux, corrige-le et revalide. Sinon, réponds par un résumé honnête de 2-3 lignes.
Je vais relire chaque point de l'architecture décrite pour vérifier qu'elle correspond aux fichiers réels présents dans le dossier de travail.

-- =============================================================================
--  hyprland.lua — entry point. ONLY require() lines live here.
--  Comment a line to disable a module. Values live in settings.conf.
-- =============================================================================

-- Core -----------------------------------------------------------------------
require("conf.env")             -- environment variables
require("conf.monitors")        -- monitor profile (monitors/*.lua)
require("conf.input")           -- keyboard, mouse, touchpad
require("conf.gestures")        -- touchpad gestures

-- Appearance -----------------------------------------------------------------
require("conf.look-and-feel")   -- gaps, borders, rounding, blur, shadows
require("conf.animations")      -- animation preset (conf/animations/*.lua)
require("conf.layouts")         -- dwindle / master options
require("conf.misc")            -- misc behaviour

-- Rules ----------------------------------------------------------------------
require("conf.windowrules")     -- floating apps, PiP, dialogs
require("conf.layerrules")      -- blur behind bar / launcher / panels
require("conf.workspaces")      -- workspace rules & scratchpad

-- Keybindings ----------------------------------------------------------------
require("conf.keybinds.apps")        -- launch applications
require("conf.keybinds.windows")     -- focus, move, resize, float, group
require("conf.keybinds.workspaces")  -- switch / move to workspaces, scratchpad
require("conf.keybinds.system")      -- launcher, menus, theme, bar, lock, reload
require("conf.keybinds.screenshots") -- capture, annotate, OCR
require("conf.keybinds.media")       -- volume, brightness, players (with OSD)
require("conf.keybinds.switches")    -- laptop lid

-- Session --------------------------------------------------------------------
require("conf.autostart")       -- daemons started once at login

-- Personal overrides (optional, loaded last, not tracked) ---------------------
require("conf.custom")

-- =============================================================================
--  conf/look-and-feel.lua — gaps, borders, rounding, opacity, blur, shadows
-- =============================================================================
--  Numbers come from settings.conf; colors from the generated theme.
--  GAMEMODE (toggled with SUPER+ALT+G) strips every effect for performance.
-- =============================================================================
local S = require("lib.settings")
local C = require("lib.colors")

local game = S.bool("GAMEMODE", false)
-- "ink" border / "hard" shadow: the hand-drawn look of the encre skin
local ink  = S.str("BORDER_STYLE", "gradient") == "ink"
local hard = S.str("SHADOW_STYLE", "soft") == "hard"

local active_border = ink and C.rgba("on_surface", "ff") or
    -- 3-accent gradient on the focused window (rotates if BORDER_ANIMATE)
    { colors = { C.rgba("a1", "ff"), C.rgba("a3", "ff"), C.rgba("a5", "ff") },
      angle = S.num("BORDER_ANGLE", 45) }

hl.config({
    general = {
        gaps_in     = game and 0 or S.num("GAPS_IN", 10),
        gaps_out    = game and 0 or S.num("GAPS_OUT", 20),
        border_size = game and 1 or S.num("BORDER_SIZE", 2),
        col = {
            active_border   = active_border,
            inactive_border = ink and C.rgba("on_surface", "99") or C.rgba("outline_variant", "40"),
        },
        resize_on_border = true,
        allow_tearing    = false,
        layout           = S.str("LAYOUT", "dwindle"),
    },

    decoration = {
        rounding           = game and 0 or S.num("ROUNDING", 10),
        rounding_power     = 2,
        active_opacity     = game and 1.0 or S.num("ACTIVE_OPACITY", 1.0),
        inactive_opacity   = game and 1.0 or S.num("INACTIVE_OPACITY", 0.9),
        fullscreen_opacity = 1.0,

        -- soft = blurred drop shadow; hard = solid ink block offset down-right
        shadow = {
            enabled        = (not game) and S.bool("SHADOW", true),
            sharp          = hard,
            range          = hard and 1 or 28,
            render_power   = hard and 1 or 3,
            offset         = hard and "5 5" or "0 6",
            color          = hard and C.rgba("shadow", "ff") or C.rgba("shadow", "45"),
            color_inactive = hard and C.rgba("shadow", "99") or C.rgba("shadow", "20"),
        },

        blur = {
            enabled           = (not game) and S.bool("BLUR", true),
            size              = S.num("BLUR_SIZE", 4),
            passes            = S.num("BLUR_PASSES", 4),
            new_optimizations = true,
            ignore_opacity    = true,
            xray              = false,
            noise             = 0.012,
            contrast          = 0.9,
            brightness        = 0.85,
            vibrancy          = 0.18,
        },
    },

    misc = {
        background_color = C.rgba("surface", "ff"),
    },
})

-- =============================================================================
--  conf/animations.lua — loads an animation preset from conf/animations/
-- =============================================================================
--  ANIMATION_PRESET (settings.conf) picks the file. ANIMATIONS=false or
--  GAMEMODE=true disable animations entirely (toggle: SUPER+SHIFT+A).
-- =============================================================================
local S = require("lib.settings")

local enabled = S.bool("ANIMATIONS", true) and not S.bool("GAMEMODE", false)
hl.config({ animations = { enabled = enabled } })

if enabled then
    local preset = S.str("ANIMATION_PRESET", "md3")
    local ok, err = pcall(require, "conf.animations." .. preset)
    if not ok then
        print("[animations] preset '" .. preset .. "' failed: " .. tostring(err))
        require("conf.animations.md3")
    end
end

-- =============================================================================
--  conf/keybinds/apps.lua — launch applications
-- =============================================================================
--  Apps are defined in settings.conf. Every bind has a description: it shows
--  up in the cheat sheet (SUPER+CTRL+K).
-- =============================================================================
local S   = require("lib.settings")
local MOD = S.str("MOD", "SUPER")
local exec = hl.dsp.exec_cmd

hl.bind(MOD .. " + RETURN", exec(S.str("TERMINAL", "kitty")),            { description = "Terminal" })
hl.bind(MOD .. " + B",      exec(S.str("BROWSER", "firefox")),           { description = "Browser" })
hl.bind(MOD .. " + E",      exec(S.str("FILEMANAGER", "nautilus")),      { description = "File manager" })
hl.bind(MOD .. " + C",      exec(S.str("CALCULATOR", "gnome-calculator")), { description = "Calculator" })

-- Personal apps (from your custom.lua)
hl.bind(MOD .. " + D", exec(S.str("APP_CHAT", "discord")),          { description = "Discord" })
hl.bind(MOD .. " + P", exec(S.str("APP_MUSIC", "spotify-launcher")), { description = "Spotify" })
hl.bind(MOD .. " + O", exec(S.str("APP_TEAMS", "teams-for-linux")),  { description = "Microsoft Teams" })

-- =============================================================================
--  conf/keybinds/windows.lua — focus, move, resize, float, fullscreen, groups
-- =============================================================================
local S   = require("lib.settings")
local MOD = S.str("MOD", "SUPER")
local exec = hl.dsp.exec_cmd

-- Close ------------------------------------------------------------------------
hl.bind(MOD .. " + Q",         hl.dsp.window.close(), { description = "Close active window" })
hl.bind(MOD .. " + SHIFT + Q", exec("hyprctl activewindow -j | jq -r .pid | xargs -r kill"),
        { description = "Kill active window process" })

-- State ------------------------------------------------------------------------
hl.bind(MOD .. " + F", hl.dsp.window.fullscreen({ mode = "fullscreen", action = "toggle" }), { description = "Toggle fullscreen" })
hl.bind(MOD .. " + M", hl.dsp.window.fullscreen({ mode = "maximized",  action = "toggle" }), { description = "Toggle maximize" })
hl.bind(MOD .. " + T", hl.dsp.window.float({ action = "toggle" }), { description = "Toggle floating" })
hl.bind(MOD .. " + SHIFT + T", exec(S.script("toggle-allfloat.sh")), { description = "Toggle floating for all windows of workspace" })
hl.bind(MOD .. " + ALT + T", function()
    hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.window.float({ action = "toggle" }))
    hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.window.pin())
end, { description = "Toggle floating + pinned" })

-- Layout -----------------------------------------------------------------------
hl.bind(MOD .. " + J", hl.dsp.layout("togglesplit"), { description = "Toggle split" })
hl.bind(MOD .. " + K", hl.dsp.layout("swapsplit"),   { description = "Swap split" })
hl.bind(MOD .. " + G", hl.dsp.group.toggle(),        { description = "Toggle window group" })

-- Focus (arrows) ---------------------------------------------------------------
for _, dir in ipairs({ "left", "right", "up", "down" }) do
    hl.bind(MOD .. " + " .. dir,         hl.dsp.focus({ direction = dir }),       { description = "Focus " .. dir })
    hl.bind(MOD .. " + ALT + " .. dir,   hl.dsp.window.swap({ direction = dir }), { description = "Swap window " .. dir })
end

-- Resize (SHIFT + arrows) --------------------------------------------------------
local STEP = 100
hl.bind(MOD .. " + SHIFT + right", hl.dsp.window.resize({ x =  STEP, y = 0, relative = true }), { repeating = true, description = "Grow width" })
hl.bind(MOD .. " + SHIFT + left",  hl.dsp.window.resize({ x = -STEP, y = 0, relative = true }), { repeating = true, description = "Shrink width" })
hl.bind(MOD .. " + SHIFT + down",  hl.dsp.window.resize({ x = 0, y =  STEP, relative = true }), { repeating = true, description = "Grow height" })
hl.bind(MOD .. " + SHIFT + up",    hl.dsp.window.resize({ x = 0, y = -STEP, relative = true }), { repeating = true, description = "Shrink height" })

-- Mouse --------------------------------------------------------------------------
hl.bind(MOD .. " + mouse:272", hl.dsp.window.drag(),   { mouse = true, description = "Move window (drag)" })
hl.bind(MOD .. " + mouse:273", hl.dsp.window.resize(), { mouse = true, description = "Resize window (drag)" })

-- =============================================================================
--  conf/keybinds/workspaces.lua — workspaces & scratchpad
-- =============================================================================
--  With an AZERTY layout (KB_LAYOUT="fr") the number row keys are used
--  unshifted: & é " ' ( - è _ ç à
-- =============================================================================
local S   = require("lib.settings")

-- =============================================================================
--  conf/keybinds/windows.lua — focus, move, resize, float, fullscreen, groups
-- =============================================================================
local S   = require("lib.settings")
local MOD = S.str("MOD", "SUPER")
local exec = hl.dsp.exec_cmd

-- Close ------------------------------------------------------------------------
hl.bind(MOD .. " + Q",         hl.dsp.window.close(), { description = "Close active window" })
hl.bind(MOD .. " + SHIFT + Q", exec("hyprctl activewindow -j | jq -r .pid | xargs -r kill"),
        { description = "Kill active window process" })

-- State ------------------------------------------------------------------------
hl.bind(MOD .. " + F", hl.dsp.window.fullscreen({ mode = "fullscreen", action = "toggle" }), { description = "Toggle fullscreen" })
hl.bind(MOD .. " + M", hl.dsp.window.fullscreen({ mode = "maximized",  action = "toggle" }), { description = "Toggle maximize" })
hl.bind(MOD .. " + T", hl.dsp.window.float({ action = "toggle" }), { description = "Toggle floating" })
hl.bind(MOD .. " + SHIFT + T", exec(S.script("toggle-allfloat.sh")), { description = "Toggle floating for all windows of workspace" })
hl.bind(MOD .. " + ALT + T", function()
    hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.window.float({ action = "toggle" }))
    hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.window.pin())
end, { description = "Toggle floating + pinned" })

-- Layout -----------------------------------------------------------------------
hl.bind(MOD .. " + J", hl.dsp.layout("togglesplit"), { description = "Toggle split" })
hl.bind(MOD .. " + K", hl.dsp.layout("swapsplit"),   { description = "Swap split" })
hl.bind(MOD .. " + G", hl.dsp.group.toggle(),        { description = "Toggle window group" })

-- Focus (arrows) ---------------------------------------------------------------
for _, dir in ipairs({ "left", "right", "up", "down" }) do
    hl.bind(MOD .. " + " .. dir,         hl.dsp.focus({ direction = dir }),       { description = "Focus " .. dir })
    hl.bind(MOD .. " + ALT + " .. dir,   hl.dsp.window.swap({ direction = dir }), { description = "Swap window " .. dir })
end

-- Resize (SHIFT + arrows) --------------------------------------------------------
local STEP = 100
hl.bind(MOD .. " + SHIFT + right", hl.dsp.window.resize({ x =  STEP, y = 0, relative = true }), { repeating = true, description = "Grow width" })
hl.bind(MOD .. " + SHIFT + left",  hl.dsp.window.resize({ x = -STEP, y = 0, relative = true }), { repeating = true, description = "Shrink width" })
hl.bind(MOD .. " + SHIFT + down",  hl.dsp.window.resize({ x = 0, y =  STEP, relative = true }), { repeating = true, description = "Grow height" })
hl.bind(MOD .. " + SHIFT + up",    hl.dsp.window.resize({ x = 0, y = -STEP, relative = true }), { repeating = true, description = "Shrink height" })

-- Mouse --------------------------------------------------------------------------
hl.bind(MOD .. " + mouse:272", hl.dsp.window.drag(),   { mouse = true, description = "Move window (drag)" })
hl.bind(MOD .. " + mouse:273", hl.dsp.window.resize(), { mouse = true, description = "Resize window (drag)" })
